all_quotes.quote: We present spatially-resolved imaging obtained with the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA) of three CO lines in two high-redshift gravitationally lensed dusty star-forming galaxies, discovered by the South Pole Telescope.
SPT-S J034640-5204.9 (SPT0346-52), at $z=5.66$, is among the highest-redshift DSFGs known.
SPT-S J053816-5030.8 (SPT0538-50), at $z=2.78$, is representative of the typical DSFG population in redshift, 870 $\mu\rm{m}$ flux density, and dust temperature.
